description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver implementing GPIO button hotplug functionality, including handling of GPIO inputs, IRQs, and uevent notifications.

methods.name: bh_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a formatted variable string to a uevent message buffer.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills a uevent message with button event variables.

methods.name: button_hotplug_work
methods.description: Handles the work of broadcasting a button hotplug event.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a button hotplug event.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button map.

methods.name: gpio_button_get_value
methods.description: Reads the current value of a GPIO button.

methods.name: gpio_keys_handle_button
methods.description: Processes a button state change and generates events.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_queue_work
methods.description: Schedules polling work for GPIO keys.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_poll
methods.description: Polls GPIO keys and handles button states.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_close
methods.description: Stops polling and disables GPIO keys.

methods.name: gpio_keys_irq_work_func
methods.description: Handles IRQ work for GPIO keys.

methods.name: button_handle_irq
methods.description: IRQ handler for GPIO button presses.

methods.name: gpio_keys_get_devtree_pdata
methods.description: Retrieves platform data from device tree.

methods.name: gpio_keys_button_probe
methods.description: Probes and initializes GPIO button device.

methods.name: gpio_keys_probe
methods.description: Main probe function for gpio-keys driver.

methods.name: gpio_keys_polled_probe
methods.description: Probe function for polled GPIO keys.

methods.name: gpio_keys_irq_close
methods.description: Disables IRQs and cancels work for GPIO keys.

methods.name: gpio_keys_remove
methods.description: Removes GPIO keys device and cleans up.

methods.name: gpio_button_init
methods.description: Initializes and registers GPIO button drivers.

methods.name: gpio_button_exit
methods.description: Unregisters GPIO button drivers.
